name: WikiHop: Multi-Hop Reading Comprehension Benchmark
description: WikiHop is a multi-hop reading comprehension dataset constructed from Wikipedia articles and Wikidata relations. Requiring models to synthesize information across multiple documents to answer questions, it consists of 51,318 question-answer examples across documented training, development, and test splits.
